checks.result: Full non-system suite: 1607 runs, 5102 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skips. The seed-dependent RackAttack csrf_detected error did not reproduce this run.
checks.follow_up: Run via ruby -Itest glob loader, NOT `bin/rails test`: the rake path pulls test:prepare -> css:install and aborts without bun, and a piped exit 0 masks the abort.

checks.result: Integration sessions do NOT persist here: IntegrationTestCase#sign_in sets session[:current_session_id] but the cookie is never written, so the next request is anonymous.
checks.follow_up: So a test asserting 'redirects to root_path' can pass for the wrong reason (authenticate_user! redirects there too). Use ActionController::TestCase with @request.session, and add a happy-path 200 assertion.

checks.result: bin/rubocop 601 files no offenses; bin/rails zeitwerk:check all good; bin/lint-design-system 43 pre-existing DS010 warnings, none blocking, none introduced.
checks.follow_up: bun is NOT on PATH by default - export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" before prettier or bun test.

checks.result: The self-hosted runner's mise-shim race (ETXTBSY, exit 126) is a runner-side concurrency problem, not a branch problem. A bounded retry in the install step is the repo-side mitigation.
checks.follow_up: The durable fix is the runner's job-concurrency setting, outside this repo. The workflow's App has no `workflows` permission, so a direct push of check.yml is refused - go through the normal PR path.
